definitions.name: recruitment-ai-system
definitions.meaning: An AI system intended for recruitment or selection. This local scope alone does not decide its high-risk classification.

definitions.name: ai-provider
definitions.meaning: A person or body that develops or commissions an AI system or general-purpose model and places it on the market or puts the system into service under its own name or trademark.

definitions.name: ai-deployer
definitions.meaning: A person or body using an AI system under its authority, excluding personal non-professional activity.

definitions.name: recruitment-activity
definitions.meaning: An activity in recruitment or selection; its category describes intended use without deciding legal classification.

attributes.name: category
attributes.meaning: Category in an open vocabulary of recruitment uses.

definitions.name: legal-provision
definitions.meaning: An addressable article, paragraph or annex item in a specific legislative resource.

attributes.name: document-name
attributes.meaning: Display title retained for reading.

attributes.name: provision-code
attributes.meaning: Local locator such as Article 13(3)(d).

definitions.name: ai-system
definitions.meaning: A machine-based system with varying autonomy and possible adaptiveness that infers from input how to generate outputs capable of influencing physical or virtual environments.

definitions.name: high-risk-recruitment-ai-system
definitions.meaning: A recruitment AI system classified as high-risk under Article 6, preserving the qualification and profiling provision in Article 6(3).

definitions.name: intended-purpose
definitions.meaning: The provider-specified intended use, including context and conditions described in supplied information.

attributes.name: use-description
attributes.meaning: Use described by the provider.

attributes.name: context
attributes.meaning: Context of intended use.

attributes.name: conditions
attributes.meaning: Conditions governing intended use.
attributes.qualification: Unordered collection selected for this capture contract.

definitions.name: candidate
definitions.meaning: A natural person being considered in recruitment or selection; no statutory candidate identifier or scoring scale is assumed.

definitions.name: job-application
definitions.meaning: Information submitted for consideration in recruitment; its detailed record schema is left to the consuming application.

definitions.name: job-advertisement
definitions.meaning: A communication advertising a job opportunity, including the targeted advertising use mentioned in Annex III.

definitions.name: candidate-evaluation
definitions.meaning: An assessment of a candidate in recruitment or selection; the model does not prescribe a numerical scoring method.

definitions.name: natural-person
definitions.meaning: A human individual, distinguished from an organisation or legal-person role.

definitions.name: oversight-assignment
definitions.meaning: An application-modelled association between a deployer, a natural person and a system to which oversight responsibility is assigned.

attributes.name: competence-description
attributes.meaning: Relevant competence of the assigned person.

attributes.name: training-description
attributes.meaning: Relevant training.

attributes.name: authority-description
attributes.meaning: Authority to perform oversight.

attributes.name: support-description
attributes.meaning: Support available to the assigned person.

definitions.name: instructions-for-use
definitions.meaning: Provider-supplied information enabling the deployer to understand the intended purpose and proper use of an AI system. It remains distinct from technical documentation.

attributes.name: intended-purpose
attributes.meaning: Provider-specified intended use.

attributes.name: system
attributes.meaning: AI system covered by these instructions.

attributes.name: provider
attributes.meaning: Provider identified in the instructions.

attributes.name: provider-contact
attributes.meaning: Contact information supplied for the provider.

attributes.name: capabilities-and-limitations
attributes.meaning: Characteristics, capabilities and limitations of performance.

attributes.name: performance-information
attributes.meaning: Metrics and circumstances associated with the reported performance.
attributes.qualification: Optional unordered collection in this interoperable capture contract. Legal completeness still requires review; absence is not a finding that information is unnecessary.

attributes.name: oversight-measures
attributes.meaning: Human oversight measures identified by the provider.
attributes.qualification: Optional unordered collection in this interoperable capture contract. Legal completeness still requires review; absence is not a finding that information is unnecessary.

attributes.name: maintenance-information
attributes.meaning: Necessary maintenance and care, including frequency.

definitions.name: technical-documentation
definitions.meaning: Documentation prepared before placing a high-risk system on the market or putting it into service, maintained to support assessment of requirements; its minimum content is specified in Annex IV.

definitions.name: performance-information
definitions.meaning: A reusable structure for reported performance metrics and the circumstances in which they apply. The Act does not supply universal metric names or thresholds.

attributes.name: metric-description
attributes.meaning: Meaning and method of the reported metric.

attributes.name: reported-level
attributes.meaning: Reported level including its unit or scale, without an invented numeric threshold.

attributes.name: evaluation-context
attributes.meaning: Testing conditions and known circumstances affecting performance.

definitions.name: dataset
definitions.meaning: A collection of data described separately from its role in training, validation, testing or operation; Article 10 and deployer-controlled input data have distinct scopes.

attributes.name: roles
attributes.meaning: Roles of the dataset in the system lifecycle.

attributes.name: origin-description
attributes.meaning: Origin and collection context.

attributes.name: preparation-description
attributes.meaning: Relevant preparation operations.

attributes.name: quality-limitations
attributes.meaning: Known suitability issues or gaps, assessed against purpose.
attributes.qualification: Unordered collection selected for this capture contract.

definitions.name: automatically-generated-log
definitions.meaning: An event record automatically generated by an AI system. This model describes the record type; hosts manage actual logs.

definitions.name: human-oversight-measure
definitions.meaning: A technical or organisational measure enabling effective human oversight, built into the system or identified for deployer implementation.

attributes.name: capabilities
attributes.meaning: Oversight capabilities enabled as appropriate and proportionate.
attributes.qualification: As appropriate and proportionate; no universal mandatory checklist.

definitions.name: risk
definitions.meaning: The combination of probability of harm and its severity, considered in the intended-use and foreseeable-misuse context.

attributes.name: harm-description
attributes.meaning: Potential harm to health, safety or fundamental rights.

attributes.name: context-description
attributes.meaning: Intended use or foreseeable misuse relevant to the risk.

definitions.name: mitigation-measure
definitions.meaning: A measure selected to address an identified risk through design, controls or information, retaining its rationale and context.

definitions.name: legal-resource
definitions.meaning: A legal resource identified independently of its language expression and document format.

definitions.name: classification-assessment
definitions.meaning: A documented assessment of a system against the applicable high-risk classification conditions. Recording an assessment is not SDK adjudication.

attributes.name: rationale
attributes.meaning: Reasons relating the conclusion to the specified conditions.

attributes.name: source-edition
attributes.meaning: Legal edition against which the assessment is expressed.

definitions.name: provision-locator
definitions.meaning: Application-authored structured location within a legal resource and edition; labels are not legal document identities.

attributes.name: resource-iri
attributes.meaning: Original legal resource identity.

attributes.name: edition
attributes.meaning: Pinned legal edition.

attributes.name: location
attributes.meaning: Article, paragraph or annex item.

definitions.name: recruitment-uses
definitions.meaning: Open vocabulary of uses explicitly mentioned in Annex III(4)(a); these examples do not exhaust recruitment or decide classification.

definitions.name: dataset-roles
definitions.meaning: Application vocabulary keeping development datasets separate from operational inputs. A dataset may have more than one role.
details: closed for this application; not a statutory exhaustive list

definitions.name: oversight-capabilities
definitions.meaning: Capabilities described in Article 14(4), interpreted in their appropriate and proportionate context.

definitions.name: qualified-high-risk-classification
definitions.meaning: Recruitment purpose alone must not be stored as unconditional high-risk classification. Preserve Article 6(2)–(3), including significant-risk/task conditions and the profiling provision.

annotations.meaning: Annex III recruitment uses
The system does not pose significant harm risk to health, safety or fundamental rights, including by not materially influencing decision outcomes; preserve the specified task conditions below.
A narrowly procedural intended task.
Improving a human activity that has already been completed.
Detecting decision patterns or deviations; preserve the condition concerning replacement or influence of a completed human assessment without proper human review.
Preparing for an assessment relevant to an Annex III use case.
A provider taking the non-high-risk position documents the assessment before market placement or service; registration and availability to authorities are separate requirements.
Annex III systems profiling natural persons remain high-risk
Descriptive rule; no compliance decision is executed

definitions.name: deployer-log-retention
definitions.meaning: Deployers retain automatically generated logs to the extent they are under their control, for a period appropriate to purpose and at least six months, unless applicable Union or national law provides otherwise.

annotations.meaning: Deployer of a high-risk AI system
Retain automatically generated logs
Only logs under their control
Appropriate to intended purpose; at least six months
Applicable Union or national law may provide otherwise
Financial institutions retain logs within relevant financial-services documentation
Descriptive rule inspection, not a new SDK obligation record
Not performed; six months is not converted into a fixed number of days

definitions.name: qualified-human-oversight
definitions.meaning: High-risk-system deployers assign oversight to natural persons with the necessary competence, training, authority and support; measures retain their appropriate and proportionate context.

definitions.name: documentation-distinction
definitions.meaning: Instructions for use explain proper use to deployers. Technical documentation supports assessment under Article 11 and Annex IV. Similar subject matter is not enough to merge these definitions.

definitions.name: dataset-responsibility
definitions.meaning: Keep Article 10 training, validation and testing requirements separate from Article 26(4) requirements for input data under deployer control.

definitions.name: provider-role-change
definitions.meaning: Specified branding, substantial-modification or intended-purpose changes may transfer provider responsibilities for the particular system; preserve the qualifications of Article 25.

definitions.name: classification-decision
definitions.meaning: A descriptive table recording the Article 6 reasoning structure. Its inputs require external interpretation; no actual system is classified by this preview.
